name: automatic-refinement
instructions:
Orchestrate a bounded multi-agent refinement run that turns an idea into an evidence-backed draft and stops at refined-awaiting-review without publishing or implementing it.

Capabilities:
- plan and execute a mandatory six-role refinement graph
- route dynamic domain skills through the canonical skill graph
- enforce typed handoffs, budgets, convergence, and independent verification
- synthesize a review-ready RefinementArtifact without remote effects

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/routing/automatic-refinement/SKILL.md
handoff_description: All mandatory roles have valid handoffs, synthesis is independently verified, and a RefinementArtifact is emitted at refined-awaiting-review or a typed terminal failure is returned.
